content:
Hello!

I'm Ross, an undergraduate math and comp sci student. I just recently found out about Lean so I'm very new but everything I've seen so far has motivated me to take a deep dive.

That said, I'd love to try making my first contribution to mathlib by tackling issue #13544. I saw a previous PR was closed because it used AI. Does this mean that I can claim it? I don't use AI, promise.

As far as I understand, the task at hand is simply renaming all of the rpow_* theorems following the same naming convention as PR #9095. If that's the case, I should be able to get this done and submit a pull request by the end of this week.

I've read the contributor's guidelines. Please let me know if there's anything important I should know before getting started.

I look forward to learning more about Lean and mathlib and contributing to the community.

Regards,
Ross
